```python
import gurobipy as gp
from gurobipy import GRB

# Jobdaten
jobs = {
    "0": {"processing_time": 7, "due_date": 779, "weight": 5},
    "1": {"processing_time": 22, "due_date": 588, "weight": 3},
    "2": {"processing_time": 58, "due_date": 733, "weight": 3},
    "3": {"processing_time": 82, "due_date": 401, "weight": 4},
    "4": {"processing_time": 46, "due_date": 425, "weight": 6},
    "5": {"processing_time": 77, "due_date": 815, "weight": 2},
    "6": {"processing_time": 63, "due_date": 253, "weight": 1},
    "7": {"processing_time": 71, "due_date": 642, "weight": 3},
    "8": {"processing_time": 52, "due_date": 249, "weight": 5},
    "9": {"processing_time": 97, "due_date": 245, "weight": 6},
    "10": {"processing_time": 84, "due_date": 348, "weight": 1},
    "11": {"processing_time": 37, "due_date": 291, "weight": 4},
    "12": {"processing_time": 38, "due_date": 466, "weight": 8},
    "13": {"processing_time": 93, "due_date": 580, "weight": 6},
    "14": {"processing_time": 61, "due_date": 803, "weight": 2},
    "15": {"processing_time": 62, "due_date": 215, "weight": 6},
    "16": {"processing_time": 64, "due_date": 419, "weight": 4},
    "17": {"processing_time": 74, "due_date": 378, "weight": 7},
    "18": {"processing_time": 79, "due_date": 448, "weight": 2},
    "19": {"processing_time": 65, "due_date": 152, "weight": 3}
}

# Erstelle das Modell
model = gp.Model("single_machine_scheduling")
model.Params.OutputFlag = 0

# Variablen
n = len(jobs)
x = model.addVars(n, n, vtype=GRB.BINARY, name="x")
C = model.addVars(n, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name="C")
T = model.addVars(n, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name="T")

# Ziel: Minimiere die gewichtete Summe der Verspätungen
model.setObjective(gp.quicksum(jobs[str(j)]["weight"] * T[j] for j in range(n)), GRB.MINIMIZE)

# Einschränkungen
# Jeder Job wird genau einmal eingeplant
model.addConstrs((gp.quicksum(x[i, j] for j in range(n)) == 1 for i in range(n)), name="assign_once")

# Jeder Platz wird genau einmal belegt
model.addConstrs((gp.quicksum(x[i, j] for i in range(n)) == 1 for j in range(n)), name="place_once")

# Berechnung der Fertigstellungszeiten
model.addConstrs((C[j] >= gp.quicksum(jobs[str(i)]["processing_time"] * x[i, j] for i in range(n)) +
                  (C[j-1] if j > 0 else 0) for j in range(n)), name="completion_time")

# Berechnung der Verspätungen
model.addConstrs((T[j] >= C[j] - jobs[str(j)]["due_date"] for j in range(n)), name="tardiness")

# Optimierung
model.optimize()

# Bestimme die Sequenz
sequence = [j for j in range(n) for i in range(n) if x[i, j].X > 0.5]

# Ausgabe
result = {
    "sequence": sequence,
    "objective_value": model.ObjVal
}

import json
print(json.dumps(result))
```
